A dog that won't come back when you call:
A dog that won't come back when you call is a liability, not a partner. Work with yours: make it follow you, sit when it's told and come when it's called. You'll find the commands under DOG in your gesture menu.

Then, out there, a dog in the open is a target. Put armour on her, a proper protective jacket, class two or better, and take her into the fights she was trained for. Combat mode, your people call it. Survive three raids together. And when someone comes at you, let her do what she does: five enemies down with your dog at your side.

Before the conflict Dr. Yang ran the onl: Before the conflict Dr. Yang ran the only veterinary clinic in Tarkov. He stayed for the animals that were left behind, and now keeps the city's working dogs fed, watered and patched up - for a fair price.
Before the conflict the city's police ke:
Before the conflict the city's police kennel boarded its dogs with us. When the shooting started, the staff ran and the dogs scattered. One of them, Rex of unit seven, had a handler who went looking for him and never came back. I want to know where those dogs went.

Start with Rex's identification tag. Scavs pick up anything that shines, and PMCs take whatever the scavs had, so search everyone you put down, on any map. On Customs they also turn up in the scav corpses lying about, in jacket pockets and at the back of drawers. Find it yourself; I don't want something somebody sold you.
Bring them to the clinic. And don't open: Bring them to the clinic. And don't open the tins on the way, I know what soldiers' rations taste like.

The only thing that heals your dog, and for your dog only: use it with your dog beside you and you treat the dog. A full kit restores all of its health, a part-used one its share, and only what the dog needs is used (it goes half as far again at a kennel with a veterinary station).

Never worn. Make sure it gets dirty.

One of them made it. A hunter saw a dog:
One of them made it. A hunter saw a dog living in the ZB-016 bunker on the Woods: thin, wary, still wearing what's left of a service harness. She won't come to a stranger, and she will bite.

Don't try to catch her. Leave food and water in the bunker, then get out of there alive. She'll follow the scent, and if she trusts you she'll be at my door by the time you get back. If you have no dog of your own, she will be yours. If you already have one, she'll stay with me; I always have room for one more. Either way you'll need somewhere proper to keep a dog.
Raw meat portions for dogs (40% hunger f: Raw meat portions for dogs (40% hunger for your dog). Cheaper than canned food. Found wherever dried beef is, and scavs carry it. People can eat it too, if they're desperate: very little energy, and a lot of thirst.
Rex's tag. Scratched, but you can still: Rex's tag. Scratched, but you can still read it, and his unit number is on my old boarding list: six dogs on the last truck, bound for a 'temporary kennel' in the Woods. Temporary. The army's favourite word. Find me that dog and I'll sell you proper protective jackets for her. And take these: the army left more than dogs behind.
Rex's tag. Search every scav and PMC you: Rex's tag. Search every scav and PMC you put down.
She came in at dawn, limping, with her n: She came in at dawn, limping, with her nose full of your scent. She let me look at her paw. That is trust; don't waste it. Now build her a kennel. I've marked out a corner of your rest area for it: you'll find the plans under the Rest Space in your hideout. Bring the materials and build it properly. And here's a black collar for her, better than that rag: put it in her collar slot in the DOG tab.
She watches your hands now, not the gunf: She watches your hands now, not the gunfire, and her jacket stopped a round that would have gone through her lungs. I dug it out; keep it if you want a souvenir. She's earned a proper collar: a tactical one, with a buckle that won't give (it's in your reward; her collar slot is in the DOG tab). I've found fleece lining for her bed too, and the cloth to keep her jacket in one piece.
Short words, the same words every time. Then armour, then the rest.
Since the evacuation half of Tarkov's pe:
Since the evacuation half of Tarkov's pets and working dogs have gone feral, and the other half are starving in back yards, waiting for owners who aren't coming back. I stayed for them. You don't have to understand that, only help.

Before I can take in a single animal I need supplies: three tins of dog food, two bottles of clean water and a proper medical kit. Nothing fancy. Just enough that the next dog brought to my door doesn't die on the table. Find them out there, not in a shop: dog food turns up wherever tinned beef does, and scavs carry it.
Stash dog food in the ZB-016 bunker on W: Stash dog food in the ZB-016 bunker on Woods
Stash drinking water in the ZB-016 bunke: Stash drinking water in the ZB-016 bunker on Woods
Strap-on ballistic goggles cut for a dog: Strap-on ballistic goggles cut for a dog's head: smoked lens over the eyes, strap behind the ears. Put them on your dog's head in the DOG tab. Lost if the dog or you die in a raid.

Ten tins. They eat like wolves.
That will keep a dog alive for a week. Y: That will keep a dog alive for a week. You have no idea how rare that is in this city. I'll remember it.

The base had a canine unit; the unit had:
The base had a canine unit; the unit had an insignia. Its last handler wore it until the day he didn't come back. Since then those badges have gone from hand to hand: scavs and PMCs carry them for luck, and there's said to be one lying around the dorms on Customs. I'd like one back where it belongs: on the wall of my clinic, above the kennels.

And the strays keep coming in worse every week. One of my K9 veterinary kits went missing with a runner, and it turned up in that house on Customs your people call the crack house: there'll be more of them there. Bring me one you find yourself, not one you bought from me, and two medical kits besides. Then I want to see the two of you work: five raids together, both of you coming home. After that I'll give you what that handler's dog wore: the unit's elite harness.
The cloth-and-metal insignia of the base: The cloth-and-metal insignia of the base's canine unit. Scavs and PMCs carry them for luck, and they turn up in the Dorms on Customs. Dr. Yang's K9 questline.
The insignia, a vet kit from the crack h: The insignia, a vet kit from the crack house, then five raids. Bring her home every time.
The strays eat every day. So do I, nearl: The strays eat every day. So do I, nearly. Five tins of dog food, please. (Contract: available again 24 hours after you complete it.)
There. It's back where it belongs, and t: There. It's back where it belongs, and the kit is back in my cupboard; I'll keep making more: come and buy them when you need them. You will. And this is yours: the elite harness, plated. Light, tough and armoured like a tank. She'll look like she owns the place, which, frankly, she does. Come by any time; there's always work for a handler and a good dog.
Three items. Sealed if you can.
